auth.login_subtitle: Sign in to log hours and track payments.
auth.register_subtitle: Set your rate, log your days, see what you earn.
auth.rate_hint: Used to price your personal time entries. You can change it later.

home.hero_sub: Daily time entries, date-filtered reports, and instant payout math for teams that bill by the hour.
home.hero_note: Free to start. No card required.
home.widget_hint: Tap a day to log hours
home.roles_sub: Managers commit a budget and pay from the report. Members set their own rate and watch the month add up. Both see the same numbers.
home.manager_desc: Enter how much money you plan to give, then pay from the date-filtered report at month end.
home.m2: See owed, paid, and remaining for everyone
home.member_desc: Set what an hour is worth to you, log each day, and know your total before the month closes.
home.u2: Log hours per day in seconds
home.u3: See running totals per date range
home.u4: Track what has been paid to you
home.c1_desc: Reports, summaries, and payment history all filter by start and end date. Month end, last two weeks, or a single day.
home.c3_desc: Every entry prices itself the moment you save it, from your rate or the group rate.
home.c4_desc: Personal entries use the hourly rate on your profile. Group entries use the rate your manager set.
home.c5_desc: Nothing is overwritten. Every payout is a record tied to the period it settled.
home.c5_item1: Reports show owed vs paid side by side
home.c5_item2: Partial payouts settle the oldest work first
home.report_sub: Pick a range, get every member with hours, amount owed, amount paid, and what still stands. Overpaying shows up too.
home.cta_title: Close your next month in one view
home.cta_sub: Create an account, log a day, and see the math before you commit to anything.
home.footer_tagline: Hours in, pay settled, audit trail intact.

dashboard.overview: Your hours and earnings for the selected period.
dashboard.no_logs: No entries in this period. Log your first day.
